props.name: title
props.description: Accessible title naming the dialog.

props.name: hideTitle
props.description: Visually hide the title while keeping it as the dialog's accessible name (announced by screen readers via `aria-labelledby`). The title text is always required; this only controls whether it is shown.

props.name: description
props.description: Optional description, wired via `aria-describedby`.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible label for the close button.

props.name: footerClose
props.description: Show an optional close/cancel button on the footer's leading (left) edge. The trailing (right) edge holds the action buttons from the `footer` slot.

props.name: initialFocus
props.description: CSS selector (within the panel) for the element to focus on open. When omitted, focus lands on the panel itself — never on the close button.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the dialog opens/closes.
